boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on the South Crouse Avenue, Marshall Street, and University Avenue corridors beside SUNY ESF and Syracuse University.

cards.title: Brooklyn Pickle — Marshall St
cards.subtitle: Marshall Street corridor
cards.notes: Use this 103 Marshall Street stop for a sandwich, soup, or salad; confirm the posted hours before walking over, especially on Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A documented Marshall Street sandwich-shop stop with dine-in or takeout options.
cards.evidence_claim: Brooklyn Pickle’s official Marshall Street page lists its Syracuse location at 103 Marshall St and identifies sandwiches, soups, and salads.
cards.access_notes: Located at 103 Marshall St, Syracuse, NY 13210; the official page posts hours and ordering links.

cards.title: Poke Fish
cards.subtitle: Marshall Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to the second-floor address at 129 Marshall Street when a build-your-own poke bowl or another listed dish fits the plan.
cards.short_summary: A documented upstairs poke-bowl restaurant on Marshall Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Poke Fish’s official site places the restaurant at 129 Marshall St, #2fl, Syracuse and describes poke bowls and other menu dishes.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 129 Marshall St, #2fl and an order link; check its live hours before visiting.

cards.title: Varsity Pizza
cards.subtitle: South Crouse Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk to 802 South Crouse Avenue for a slice, wrap, breakfast item, or other current menu choice; use the site’s hours for timing.
cards.short_summary: A long-running food stop on the South Crouse Avenue edge of the campus district.
cards.evidence_claim: Varsity Pizza’s official site lists 802 S. Crouse Avenue and describes pizza, wraps, breakfast, and catering.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 802 S. Crouse Avenue and weekly hours; check the live schedule because holiday and event updates are noted.

cards.title: Five Guys — South Crouse Avenue
cards.subtitle: South Crouse Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the 727 South Crouse Avenue storefront when burgers, fries, or a made-to-order milkshake are on the day’s food plan.
cards.short_summary: A named quick-service restaurant directly on the South Crouse Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Five Guys at 727 S. Crouse Ave.
cards.access_notes: The business-district site identifies South Crouse Avenue as one of the main thoroughfares where campus meets the community.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill — Marshall Street
cards.subtitle: Marshall Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 129 Marshall Street for a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, or salad order, choosing from the restaurant’s current menu.
cards.short_summary: A named customizable-meal stop in the Marshall Street commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Chipotle Mexican Grill at 129 Marshall St.
cards.access_notes: The district site describes Marshall Street as a main thoroughfare of the campus-community business district.

cards.title: Kabul Restaurant
cards.subtitle: South Crouse Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Choose this 701 South Crouse Avenue restaurant for an Afghan-food meal; review the current menu or ordering information before going.
cards.short_summary: A named Afghan restaurant at the South Crouse Avenue end of the district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Kabul Restaurant at 701 South Crouse Avenue.
cards.access_notes: South Crouse Avenue is identified by the district as one of its main campus-community thoroughfares.

cards.title: Salt City Coffee
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the 720 University Avenue coffee stop for a drink or café item, and check its current service details before making a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: A named coffee destination in the Marshall Square Mall block on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Salt City Coffee at 720 University Ave.
cards.access_notes: The district site identifies the adjacent commercial area as serving SUNY ESF and Syracuse University students, among others.

cards.title: Collegetown Bagels
cards.subtitle: Marshall Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the 177 Marshall Street storefront for a bagel, breakfast, or café order, checking the business’s current location information first.
cards.short_summary: A named bagel-and-café stop at the east end of the Marshall Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Collegetown Bagels at 177 Marshall St.
cards.access_notes: Marshall Street is identified by the district as a main thoroughfare where campus meets the community.

cards.title: Oishi Sushi
cards.subtitle: South Crouse Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the 701 South Crouse Avenue address for sushi or another current menu choice; consult the restaurant directly for availability and timing.
cards.short_summary: A named sushi restaurant sharing the South Crouse Avenue commercial block.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Oishi Sushi at 701 S. Crouse Ave.
cards.access_notes: The business district’s homepage identifies South Crouse Avenue as a principal corridor beside the campuses.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies — Marshall Street
cards.subtitle: Marshall Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 137 Marshall Street bakery when cookies, brownies, or ice cream are wanted; check the store locator for current hours and ordering.
cards.short_summary: A named dessert-bakery stop on the Marshall Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crouse-Marshall Business District’s current directory lists Insomnia Cookies at 137 Marshall St.
cards.access_notes: The district identifies Marshall Street as one of the main thoroughfares in the campus-community commercial district.
